$description: CODE-OWNED. Not in Figma, and not overwritten by `npm run sync:figma`. Component tokens the semantic layer needs but the designer's Figma file does not yet export. Delete an entry here the moment the sync starts producing it.

component.$description: The tertiary button pair. DESIGN.md specifies three button treatments, but colors-semantic in Figma exports only primary and secondary, so the quiet third one lives here until the designer adds it.

tertiary.$description: Quiet third button fill. Aliases the raised content surface rather than a primitive, so it re-aliases in dark mode for free.

label-tertiary.$description: Label for btn.tertiary. Aliases body text, so the pair inherits the already-gated `foreground.body-text on surface.2` contrast check in BOTH modes — see PAIRS in scripts/validate-tokens.mjs.
